label: Bible Study
prompt: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine _____:
verse: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:
note: Right after 'love the LORD thy God' — the words go in the heart first, then onto doorposts and into conversation.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy _____; write them upon the table of thine heart:
verse: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
note: Wear mercy and truth like a necklace and write them on your heart — jewelry that never goes out of style.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And bring hither the _____ calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:
verse: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:
note: The fatted calf was saved for a big celebration — and the prodigal's homecoming was exactly that.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor _____ heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.
verse: But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.
note: Often read as describing heaven, but the next verse says God has revealed these things to us by his Spirit.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: In those days there was no king in Israel, but every man did that which was _____ in his own eyes.
verse: In those days there was no king in Israel, but every man did that which was right in his own eyes.
note: The refrain of Judges: no king in Israel, and 'every man did that which was right in his own eyes.' It closes the book too (21:25).
